name: Prayerlessness
overview: Scripture reveals that prayerlessness is characterized by a rejection of reverence and communication with God, as seen in Job's rebuke of those who cast off fear and restrain prayer before Him. The workers of iniquity are depicted as lacking knowledge because they do not call upon the Lord, treating His people as easily consumed. This attitude is further emphasized by those who dismiss the Almighty and question the value of serving or praying to Him, effectively turning away from the knowledge of God's ways.
